title: Fit a cordless vacuum's crevice tool and vacuum the grit out of a narrow gap
instruction: Fit the crevice tool to the vacuum, switch it on and vacuum the grit out of the gap.
context: Fitting the crevice tool to clear crumbs and grit from a gap the floor head can't reach (car seats, sofas) is everyday cordless-vacuum use. The difficulty is physical: the collar must go into the inlet square until it clicks, and the 1.7 kg machine, held by its handle, must be tilted so the tool's tip reaches the floor of a 10 cm deep gap and is drawn along both walls.
setup: Positions in cm from the midpoint between the arm bases (x forward, y left); heights above the table. Vacuum: Dyson V8 Cyclone (model SV55) main body (handheld, no wand), 32 cm long, about 1.7 kg; unlike the earlier Dyson V8's trigger, its power is a red push-on/push-off button on top of the body (user manual, 'Operating your machine': 'The top button turns your vacuum on and off'); switched off, standing on a 28 x 14 x 9 cm wooden block centred (29.6, -6.0), inlet pointing forward (+x), inlet's front at (49.6, -6.0), 18.8 cm up. Crevice tool: Dyson 967612-01 (collar 35 mm across, blade 175 x 17.2 x 24.7 mm, thin side across y, about 40 g) in a wooden cradle on the inlet's axis, collar 3.0 cm in front of the inlet, a stop 1 mm past its tip at x 75.7. Gap: two 296 x 18 x 100 mm plywood boards on the table, inner faces at y -21.0 and -24.0, from x 50.0 to 76.0; an 18 x 30 x 100 mm block closes the far end, a 6 x 30 x 6 mm strip the near end; clamped. Grit: 32 g of 2-3 mm rounded quartz aquarium gravel (Olibetta Crystal Quartz) spread evenly along the gap's floor. The README gives the cradle's sizes.
scoring: Tools: kitchen scale (0.1 g), cup. Tool on: at the end the crevice tool is pushed home and its catch engaged (it does not come off when pulled without pressing its release button). Vacuumed: empty the bin before the trial; afterwards empty it into the cup and weigh the grit, out of 32 g; grit pushed out of the gap or picked up any other way does not count. 0 if the tool is not on at the end or under 25% is vacuumed; with the tool on: 0.25 for 25% or more, 0.5 for 50%, 0.75 for 75%, 1.0 for 85% or more, held for 1 s.
reset_notes: Switch the vacuum off, press the tool's release button and pull it off, empty the bin back into the gravel's jar, stand the vacuum and tool back in place, and spread 32 g of gravel evenly along the gap again. The gravel is reusable.
fidelity: Rigid-body PhysX at 240 Hz. Vacuum and tool are rigid bodies from boxes and cylinders, sized from Dyson's figures and manual drawing; the catch is a sprung tooth that drops into a groove on the collar; catch and button forces and the centre of mass are not published (light springs; centre of mass over the handle). Grit: 1,411 rigid 2-3 mm quartz spheres, scored by mass. Suction is not simulated as airflow: while on, a grain within 4 mm of the opening is taken into the machine.
